# Metro Detroit Mailbox

Metro Detroit Mailbox (Metro Detroit Mailbox LLC) is a locally owned, Michigan-based mailbox installation and repair service serving homeowners across Metro Detroit, Michigan. It is an authorized installer partner for Mail Boss, Post & Porch, and Whitehall mailboxes.

## Services

- **New Mailbox Installation**: Already have a mailbox? We install it. Need help picking one? We can help find the right fit for your home and neighborhood, including options from our brand partners, then install it. We set the post securely, ensure everything is level and meets postal regulations, call 811 before digging (at no charge), haul away the old mailbox, and clean up all debris. Most jobs take 2–4 hours.
- **Mailbox Repair**: We repair leaning or damaged posts, broken doors, and worn hardware. We restore mailboxes to like-new condition and haul away all old materials.

## Brand Partners

Metro Detroit Mailbox installs mailboxes from any brand. It is also an authorized installer partner with the following mailbox manufacturers, so customers who order a mailbox or post from these brands through us can get installer program pricing, which varies by company and product.

- **Mail Boss** (https://mailboss.com/): Locking and non-locking security mailboxes. Based in Washington.
- **Post & Porch** (https://postandporch.com/): Modern mailbox designs. Based in Utah.
- **Whitehall** (https://www.whitehallproducts.com/): Handcrafted mailboxes and address plaques since 1941. Based in Michigan.

## How It Works

1. Get a quote — contact us and send 3–5 photos of your mailbox and post. We agree on a price and schedule a date.
2. 811 utility check — we call 811 to have underground utilities marked a few days before the installation date, at no charge.
3. Professional installation — we install the post securely, clean up all trash, and haul away your old mailbox.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do I need to buy the mailbox first?**
Not necessarily. If you already have a mailbox you want installed, we're happy to install it. If you don't have one yet, we can help you find an option that works best for your home and neighborhood, then install it for you — including options from our brand partners Mail Boss, Post & Porch, and Whitehall.

**How much does installation cost?**
Pricing varies by job — it depends on your location, supplies needed, and the time required to do the work right. Most jobs range from $200–$600, though some are more and some are less.

**Can I get a discount on my mailbox?**
Yes — we're an authorized installer partner with Mail Boss, Whitehall, and Post & Porch. If you see a mailbox and/or post you like from one of these three companies, let us know and we can price it out for you. We still install mailboxes from any brand — installer pricing just applies to these three partners for now.

**Do you call 811 before digging?**
Yes, always — at no extra charge. We call 811 and schedule them to mark underground utilities a few days before your installation date.

**How long does installation take?**
Most jobs take 2–4 hours from start to finish.

**Do you haul away my old mailbox?**
Yes. We remove your old mailbox, haul away all debris, and leave your yard clean.

**What should I include when I reach out for a quote?**
Sending 3–5 photos of your mailbox and post along with your message helps us give you a faster, more accurate quote with less back-and-forth.

**What areas do you serve?**
We serve homeowners throughout Oakland, Wayne, Macomb, Livingston, and Washtenaw counties — including Troy, Farmington Hills, Novi, Rochester Hills, Sterling Heights, Shelby Township, Macomb Township, Clinton Township, Canton Township, Livonia, Grosse Pointe, Brighton, Howell, Ann Arbor, Ypsilanti, and surrounding Metro Detroit communities.
